americancurl: An American curl cat seen from a THREE-QUARTER FRONT VIEW, facing toward the viewer and slightly turned - its face and chest are visible and it is NOT seen from behind. A medium silky-coated cat whose one distinguishing feature is its EARS: each ear rises from a wide firm base and then, starting about a third of the way up, CURVES BACKWARD IN ONE CONTINUOUS ARC toward the back of the skull - the ear's silhouette looks like a backward-leaning capital C or a comma shape, open and firm along its whole length. The ear tip ends up pointing back and slightly down toward the nape of the neck, clearly bent away from its base direction, not standing straight upright like an ordinary cat's ear. It has EXACTLY ONE TAIL, a single plumed tail and no more. Sitting upright. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
